name: solo-business-idea-review
description: Audit and stress-test a one-person business idea with current evidence, hard blockers, solo-operability scoring, an explicit verdict, and the next decisive test.

invocation_policy.semantic_trigger: the user presents or refers to one or more already-described business ideas and asks whether they are good, worth pursuing, viable, validated, risky, or suitable for a solo founder, or asks for a go/no-go review, evidence check, hard blockers, the riskiest assumption, comparison, or cheapest validation experiment, rather than open-ended generation of new ideas, regardless of language
